messages:
Alex K.: Morning check-in — quick release pulse. What I did: landed KV cache backfill (PR #4123) into release branch and validated unit tests. Blockers: seeing flaky CI on GPU node f-12 (about 1/10 runs fail). Today: re-run failing PRs, coordinate with infra to warm nodes; will prepare a short changelog note. cc @Jen L. @Priya R.
Jen L.: Thanks Alex — saw #4123, looks good. I kicked a rebuild for f-12; eng-infra is investigating a kernel patch. I also have a telemetry cherry-pick (PR #4130) pending review — can we get @Sam T. to eyeball? :eyes:  
Sam T.: On my TODOs — I can review #4130 in ~30m. Not a hard blocker for the train but we should avoid any quantization changes in this batch (we saw a perf blip last run).
Priya R.: FYI deploy-bot shows mixed canary results. eu-west-1 passed, us-west-2 failed on latency threshold.
deploy-bot: Canary results for release/v1.3.2 — eu-west-1: PASS, us-west-2: FAIL (p99 latency 230ms > 200ms). Logs: https://internal-logs/release/3135792468/canary 
Marco P.: I'll take the us-west-2 investigation. Initial look: autoscaler didn't scale up extra nodes for canary. Might be quota bump or ASG health check flapping. Pinged eng-infra on the ticket.
Alex K.: Thanks Marco. If autoscaler needs manual capacity bump, ping me and I'll allocate reserved capacity for the train. Reminder: cherry-pick window closes at 17:00 UTC today.
Jen L.: Quick question — is PR #4109 (model routing fallback) still on hold? It's marked ready but not merged.
Sam T.: I left a couple comments on #4109, will push updates tonight. It's not blocking canary but worth landing pre-cut if possible.
Alex K.: Plan: if infra fix for us-west isn't in by 14:00 UTC, we cut the train without telemetry #4130 and proceed. I'll open a tiny changelog PR now to include known items.
Jen L.: Ack — thanks. :thumbsup:
Alex K.: Reassigning follow-ups: Marco owns us-west debugging; Sam to finish reviews; Jen to coordinate changelog entry with me. I'll update this thread after infra patch or if we cut the train.
